payload.content: ONLY for ratio/percentage/proportion questions (e.g. 'what percentage', 'what proportion', 'what is the ratio'), CAST the numerator to REAL before division: CAST(numerator AS REAL) * 100 / denominator. Without the CAST, SQLite performs integer division and produces 0 or wrong percentages. Use ROUND(..., N) only when the question asks for N decimal places.

rationale: Bird q_asks_ratio=yes (69% fail) often produces integer-division zeros. Predicate: question matches r'\b(percentage|proportion|ratio|percent of|what fraction)\b'. Gated to ratio questions only.
